label: Plakát
purpose: The owner's poster look of 8 November 2026: a colour photograph to every edge under a dark fade, one tall condensed headline in capitals at the foot with its key words in a lighter blue, and blue for the text-only slide.

background.source: The ink of the approved mockup: the ground and the shade every photograph fades into.

surface.source: The copy under a headline, a shade under white so the headline stays the brightest thing on the slide (the mockup's white at 88 %).

surface-strong.source: --text-secondary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md: hairlines and thumbnail frames on the legacy sources slide.

foreground.source: The headline on a photograph, on ink and on blue.

muted.source: Labels on ink, shared with the spotlight look; 5.7:1 on the ink ground.

accent.source: The icy blue of the new avatar (owner, 8 November 2026): the ground of the text-only slide, with ink words on it.

secondary.source: The icy blue of the new avatar (owner, 8 November 2026): the key words of a headline on a photograph or on ink, unless the post sets its own colour.

headline.source: The approved mockup's condensed display face, set in capitals: the poster headline, with drawn Czech accents.

body.source: The copy under a headline, quieter than the display face.

mono.source: BRAND_SYSTEM.md: the legacy sources slide's disclosure line, the only mono text in the kit.
